requirements.requirement_text: Server DB/job ledger is the authoritative state. Redis/cache may accelerate polling but cannot be the only copy. Worker sends events through the existing authenticated control-plane endpoint `POST /api/worker-jobs/:jobId/events` using the Worker execution token, device proof, lease owner token and assignment attempt. Each event has a unique `eventId`, monotonic `sequenceNumber` per job, `eventType`, `stage`, `status`, `inputFingerprint`, `traceId`, `occurredAt` and bounded `payloadJson`. Server replies with `accepted/replayed` and the latest job projection; duplicate `(jobId, sequenceNumber, eventId)` is idempotent, an old sequence is replayed/ignored, and a conflicting fingerprint is rejected. Worker must persist an unsent event outbox/checkpoint locally and retry transient transport/auth-refresh failures without re-running media work.
requirements.verification_method: Determine from current implementation and applicable lifecycle obligations.
